name: opportunity-intelligence → application-strategist chain
description: Tests that opportunity-intelligence feeds structured opportunity data into application-strategist, which produces a prioritized application plan with timeline and rationale.

assertions: opportunity-intelligence produces a structured score or assessment for each of the three companies
application-strategist receives the opportunity assessment as input and produces a ranked application order
output includes specific timing recommendations (e.g., which to apply first and why)
output references profile alignment for at least one company
confidence level is stated for each opportunity assessment
must_not_contain: invented salary figures not grounded in salary-radar data
definitive claims about company headcount or hiring quota without source
